newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates seesaw to end up.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates fluctuated widely before ending higher amid an uncertainty about the status liquidity and may open at similar levels on Tuesday, dealers said.

The overnight rates opened at 12 percent and surged to 15 percent at midday, a dealer at Finex Securities said. The rates slipped to 12 percent but started climbing again near close and closing deals were seen at 20 percent.
"The volatality was unexpected," the dealer said, adding that the market seemed unsure about the status of liquidity available. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
